title: Willis Young's background, winters and schooling of the children
summary: Young came from Hammond, Louisiana, ran the circus side-show band, and wintered the children in schools each year.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: School days: grades, teachers and leaving school

blocks.x: Anything you know about Willis Young besides what you just told us -- that led other bands? That he had these
nephews, that he was on the Heck, Beck and Wallace show.
Circus. He had the band on a side show there.
And he was from Hammond, Louisiana. Anything else you know about him?

Well, that's where he was from, was Hammond, but he stayed on the road most of the time. They never did have no (?). That's where they kept laying... In the winter, that's where Lester and them went to school, just like he went to my home... He came there in November or October or something like that, and then they stayed there until April, and then they went to school... In Minneapolis they went to school.

Yeah. They was small; they was going to grammar school. So they would go... Like, he'd winter somewhere every winter. That's the way he traveled around with them, and then... Well, see, he had the best... I guess he should have had a lot of money when he died. I don't know whether he did -- he should have. But he made a billion dollars off of Les and them, as kids. They drew. Because you didn't see kids, talent like they were... He could sing like hell and dance, Irma could sing and dance. Les, he could sing, but he didn't want to sing because his voice was too high... They all was gifted.
